title: Disaster Preparedness & Response System
shortDescription: Scalable national platform for schools and colleges featuring interactive disaster learning modules, AR/VR virtual drills, region-specific guidance, and real-time emergency alerts via Firebase FCM.
problem: Lack of standardized disaster education and real-time response drills in educational institutions.
solution: Architected IoT sensor integration ESP32 feeding live dashboards; led end-to-end system design aligned with government disaster management frameworks for real-world deployment.
impact: Deployed as a scalable national platform for disaster readiness.

title: GovBuy
award: The Open Group INITIATE EA Competition — International Finalist
shortDescription: A full e-procurement platform for government buyers and suppliers with end-to-end tendering workflow, role-based access, and compliance-first architecture.
problem: Government tendering lacked an auditable, transparent digital workflow aligned with global enterprise architectures.
solution: Designed following TOGAF ADM and ArchiMate modelling to deliver an enterprise-grade, auditable system built for secure, scalable government procurement operations.
impact: International finalist at The Open Group INITIATE EA Competition.

title: NagarSevak
shortDescription: An AI-powered citizen platform for reporting civic issues, corruption, and infrastructure failures with geotagged multimedia submissions and offline-first support.
problem: Lack of transparent, AI-driven issue reporting for citizens and municipal authorities.
solution: Integrated YOLO-based image analysis and a trust-based prioritization engine; authorities access a real-time WebSocket-powered map dashboard with auto-routing and issue resolution tracking.
impact: Empowered citizens and streamlined civic governance workflows.

title: CyberSentinel AI
shortDescription: Real-time cyber defense platform with a browser extension featuring a floating Quickball assistant that monitors web activity to detect phishing, malicious URLs, and prompt injection attacks.
problem: Users fall victim to phishing and malicious web attacks due to a lack of real-time, explainable threat detection.
solution: Developed an AI-powered threat analysis pipeline with explainable insights (risk scoring, indicators, actions).
impact: Provides real-time explainable defense against zero-day phishing and prompt injections.

title: JalSevak
shortDescription: Real-time coastal monitoring system aggregating geotagged citizen reports and AI-analysed social media signals to detect flooding, high waves, and pollution hotspots.
problem: Delayed detection of coastal hazards and flooding.
solution: Built NLP sentiment pipelines (spaCy/Transformers) and CV models (PyTorch/TensorFlow) feeding a centralised authority dashboard with AI-generated alerts and Celery-driven async processing.
impact: Real-time early warning system for coastal regions.

title: AYUSH Startup Registration Portal
shortDescription: A government-facing portal streamlining AYUSH startup onboarding with role-based access, data aggregation, user authentication, and privacy compliance built in.

title: Robotic Garbage Collector
shortDescription: A semi-autonomous terrain-adaptive garbage collection robot (sandy/swampy environments) with real-time object detection, servo control, and obstacle avoidance.
problem: Standard cleaning robots fail in uneven terrain like swamps and sand.
solution: Built a Flutter app for manual remote control alongside the robot's fully automatic operation mode.

title: KnoQ Smart Bat
shortDescription: IoT-enabled cricket training system capturing real-time swing metrics (speed, impact, sweet spot) with BLE-based mobile integration.
problem: Lack of data-driven technique feedback for amateur cricketers.
solution: Designed MediaPipe-based vision analysis to deliver AI-driven technique feedback and player performance tracking.
impact: Revolutionizing local cricket coaching through affordable IoT and AI.

title: MediScan
shortDescription: QR/barcode scanning solution delivering instant medication information (benefits, side effects, dosage) to patients — improving healthcare accessibility through a simple scan.
